items.exampleEn: The TV station's correspondent gave a live report from the airport.
items.exampleZh: 電視台的特派記者在機場做了現場報導。

items.exampleEn: The library's database lists more than a million books.
items.exampleZh: 圖書館的資料庫列出了一百多萬本書。

items.exampleEn: We need input from every department before we make a decision.
items.exampleZh: 做決定之前，我們需要每個部門的意見。

items.exampleEn: She edits a small magazine about gardening.
items.exampleZh: 她編輯一本關於園藝的小雜誌。

items.exampleEn: The writer of this famous old poem is anonymous.
items.exampleZh: 這首有名的古詩，作者不詳。

items.exampleEn: The listeners clapped loudly when the singer finished her last song.
items.exampleZh: 歌手唱完最後一首歌時，聽眾大聲鼓掌。

items.exampleEn: Prices of electronics usually drop after the holidays.
items.exampleZh: 電子產品的價格通常在假期過後下降。

items.exampleEn: We corresponded by letter for years before we finally met.
items.exampleZh: 我們用書信往來好幾年，最後才終於見面。

items.sentenceEn: The new park was paid for by an anonymous businessman.
items.sentenceZh: 新公園是由一位匿名的商人出資興建的。

items.audioEn: The electronics store on the corner is closing early today because of the storm.
items.audioZh: 轉角那家電子產品店今天因為暴風雨提早關門。
items.questionZh: 那家店今天為什麼提早關門？

items.sentenceEn: The manager asked me to correspond with our clients in Spanish.
items.sentenceZh: 經理要我用西班牙文和我們的客戶書信往來。

items.sentenceEn: I need about an hour to edit the video before we post it online.
items.sentenceZh: 在我們把影片放上網之前，我需要大約一小時剪輯。

items.stemEn: The company keeps the names and addresses of all its customers in a ____.
items.stemZh: 那家公司把所有顧客的姓名和地址存在一個資料庫裡。

items.stemEn: Thank you for your ____; your ideas really helped the project.
items.stemZh: 謝謝你的意見，你的想法真的幫了這個專案很大的忙。

items.passageEn: Tom is a correspondent for a radio station in Taipei, and every week he reports on new electronics. Last month, an anonymous listener sent him an email about a phone that often got very hot. Tom wanted to know if other people had the same problem, so he searched the station's database of listener messages. He found more than fifty similar stories. With input from two engineers, he wrote a report and edited it carefully. The phone company had previously said the phones were safe. However, after Tom corresponded with the company by email, it finally admitted the problem. The report became the station's most popular story, and the company quickly offered free repairs.
items.passageZh: Tom 是台北一家電台的特派記者，每週報導新的電子產品。上個月，一位匿名聽眾寄電子郵件給他，說有一款手機常常變得很燙。Tom 想知道其他人是否也有同樣的問題，於是搜尋了電台的聽眾留言資料庫，找到五十多則類似的經驗。在兩位工程師提供意見下，他寫了一篇報導並仔細修改。這家手機公司先前曾說這些手機很安全。不過，在 Tom 用電子郵件和公司聯絡之後，公司終於承認了問題。這篇報導成為電台最受歡迎的新聞，公司也很快提供免費維修。

questions.questionZh: 匿名聽眾寄信給 Tom 是關於什麼？
options: 一款常常變得很燙的手機

questions.questionZh: 報導播出後，手機公司做了什麼？

items.promptZh: 這份問卷是匿名的，所以請誠實回答。
referenceEn: This survey is anonymous, so please answer honestly.
The survey is anonymous, so please be honest in your answers.
rubricZh: anonymous 指匿名的（例如 The survey is anonymous 等）
「誠實回答」可寫，例如 answer honestly、give honest answers 等
因果寫法不限（例如 …, so please answer honestly、Because …, please answer honestly 等）

items.instructionZh: 用 listener 造一個句子，說說你覺得自己是不是一個好的傾聽者。
referenceEn: I think I am a good listener because I never stop people while they are talking.
I am not a very good listener, because I often look at my phone.
rubricZh: 可用形容詞修飾 listener（例如 a good listener、a patient listener 等）
時態配合內容（例如 am、think 等）
